append.detail: EVIDENCE UPDATE 2026-10-19: Vercel project env lists NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_BROWSER_KEY and GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY (names only read, values not decrypted), so the production artifact can activate the Google provider. Still open: nobody has loaded a Frequency map in a browser against production and seen Google tiles with no fallback error; the 101 focused map tests pass on main. Closes when the owner or a browser session confirms Google rendering on the event venue, Around You and Circle discovery maps.
